packageReviews.assessment: M plausible. Split dialect parser assertions: quoted identifiers, strings, comments, escapes, positional binding and mismatched count; NON05-03 promoted identifier is a separate generator path. Disposable PG/DuckDB/BQ parity needed for provider syntax.

M plausible. Separate absent combinations from numeric X value-axis work; pivot preserves missing mask, Scatter presentation must not plot synthetic zero. Test irregular numeric spacing, series, tooltip/anomaly indices and unchanged line/bar.

M plausible. Define rounding/quantization of the displayed millisecond interval before replacing raw half-open comparison. Assert displayed start inclusive/end exclusive and raw fractional behavior independently; update characterization only with fix.
M plausible. NON-01 deterministic deferred results support same-generation lazy/explicit intent, without claiming network cancellation.

M understates combined surface. Do child Escape in shared overlay coordination first; independent form/picker focus trap and A03 delete return focus second; failed-save focus third. Distinct owners and regressions; no universal modal rewrite.
S plausible. Native pane dimensions and editor scroll in both viewport widths; preserve generated Builder height.
S plausible but two independent changes. Log write denial/retry is P1; PromQL accessible name is P2. Separate tests/commits even if packaged together; exact copy bytes retained.
S plausible but separate table resize pointer and CellFilterMenu keyboard focus owners. May schedule independently.
S plausible. Bounded structured display with exact raw copy semantics; include arrays and circular/large defensive cases.
S plausible for serialization, but verify a cold/packaged restart separately before claiming durable native acceptance.
S plausible. Null/blank and unsafe Int64 are separate input classes; preserve absence and precision, and do not infer live malformed provider response.

S plausible for relation dedupe. NON06-03 search-term uniqueness is optional low-impact normalization without a failed contract; decide independently and do not make it a gate for confirmed relation fix.

M plausible, perhaps larger under three callers. Shared slots/focus only; logs and patterns virtualize at 42/58 px while Tempo renders a nonvirtual 68 px list. Test row count, scroll positions, keyboard and request invariance.
M provisional pending stale/partial product policy; success→failure→view switching alone cannot settle persistence or export eligibility.
S provisional after UI-002 field/units/parent-child decision. IPC transport already exists.
M may conceal multiple investigations; PG diagnostics, BQ errors, SQL read-only, local-file and AI catalog authorization require independent provider/OS threat fixtures.
M provisional. Native evidence backlog is not one implementation PR; individual original image/provenance and provider checks should be independently owned.
M provisional. Picker, inspector, feedback and resize are separate policy choices; preserve native preset confirmation rather than imposing modal standard.
S plausible. Two expected failures should become positive revision/draft invariants, with native handoff.
S plausible. Check revision before each async metadata/model request, no stale model call; not authorization of SQL execution.
S plausible if independent pane and sample controls remain bounded; timing action at 652 px and sample text in filtered map have separate measurements.

Synthetic marker retention proves error-boundary behavior, not actual sensitive data disclosure. Define provider-message threat/redaction policy and test realistic ADC errors and renderer/log boundaries before a P1 ready fix; a bounded defensive fix can follow.
